messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Problems uploading to Shiny server
parts:
So strange, I will do some more testing.

Yes, you can create files on the server. If you try setwd("/home/pssguy/ShinyApps/tabPanels") it will work--this is a Linux machine, not Windows, so there aren't drive letters. However, an easier way to do it is to just create a new R file (File | New | R Script); when you save it, you'll get a dialog box that will let you choose the folder and filename, so just navigate to your tabPanels directory and make the filename ui.R or whatever.
